meta.title: MPT-Rec screening synthesis - machine-readable branch records
meta.scope: All completed screening branches of the two fair-evaluation lineages (CensusIncome: base infra/fair-stage2-benchmark @ 87afe03; AliCCP: base infra/aliccp-fair-benchmark @ 8133d32), plus the Census-side AliCCP-attenuation transfer branch and the AliCCP A3 repeatability-calibration branch (infra/aliccp-a3-repeatability-calibration @ f65412f, added in the 2026-10-04 second-pass update as the 24th entry). One record per branch.
meta.revision: 2026-10-04 second pass (same docs branch, docs-only): adds the A3 repeatability-calibration entry (24th branch; A3_PASS on the AliCCP seed-2 short Stage-2 baseline config); moves former direction D2 from recommended_directions to completed_directions (executed for AliCCP; its Census half not measured - documented, not reconciled); reframes D1 as the single researcher-led handoff (AliCCP-scoped, prior-art-aware); final recommendation: no additional automated screening experiments. No previous entry's rows, values or classification fields were altered.
meta.audit_method: Read-only audit of committed git refs: per-branch SUMMARY.md versions (artifacts/census_stage2/SUMMARY.md, artifacts/aliccp_bench/SUMMARY.md, artifacts/census_stage1_grad/SUMMARY.md), branch-local design/experiment documents, and result commit messages. Run directories, JSONs and verifier reports are gitignored and were NOT audited; all values are as recorded in committed files. No training, no model-code changes, no merges.

value_conventions.shas: 40-char commit SHAs; blobs are 40-char git blob hashes as committed at the branch tip
value_conventions.delta_reported: string exactly as documented at the cited source; validator parses decimal places (d) and requires |recomputed - reported| <= 10^-d
value_conventions.arm_auc_full / baseline_auc_full: full-precision values as given in design/experiment docs or SUMMARY rows; null when the doc only gives rounded values

not_audited: artifacts/aliccp_bench/audit/** and untracked verify_*.py scripts in worktrees (deliberately untouched)
two tooling-interrupted launch logs of the AliCCP residual-prompt-gate branch (0-byte, preserved locally, described in the design doc section 9.0)
artifacts/aliccp_bench/audit/a3-short-seed2/a3_report.json (gitignored per the A3 design section 11.2; its values are audited only as quoted in the committed A3 report document)
meta.integrity_note_refs: See docs/experiments/2026-10-04-mptrec-screening-synthesis.md section 7 for the full provenance and conflict notes; each entry below cites its evidence files.
